item.title: Backstory to Jensen Huang's Return, Iowa Explosives Dispute, Dems Reveal 2028 Plan: AM Update 11/24 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia following President Trump's intervention, as lawmakers raise national security concerns and federal investigations continue. A federal appeals court clears the way for the Army to detonate nearly five tons of hazardous explosives in Iowa, leaving the final decision dependent on the incoming governor's approval - former Navy JAG officer and federal prosecutor Don Brown weighs in. The DNC unveils its 2028 presidential primary debate schedule and new qualification requirements as the party prepares for a potentially crowded race. Anthropic's AI assistant Claude helps a mathematician develop an apparent proof of the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis, raising questions about how quickly artificial intelligence could surpass human capabilities.
